name: AnubisDB subdomain database (anubisdb.com)
operator: AnubisDB, run by the maintainer of the open-source Anubis project (jonluca/Anubis, individual operator)
tier_rationale: Individual operator without published terms or privacy policy (A8 unknown). Chair decision P016: the extra feeds stay unknown tier until a promotion is recorded, so they are opt-in and excluded at TLP:AMBER and above.

reliability.justification: Very large and noisy name list (22,253 names for example.com on 2026-11-26, with out-of-apex junk and thousands of numeric or word+digits labels): names seen only here stay unconfirmed until they resolve or a second source agrees (P016 cond 7).

subdomains.title: AnubisDB subdomain list (GET /anubis/subdomains/{domain}, JSON array)

terms.quote: Registry terms per feed (A1 BR3): THC, AnubisDB and Subdomain Center are 'open' (legal_dpo: free services with no published terms, no contractual bar)

subdomains.notes: Quote: binding council text (P016 cond 4). https://anubisdb.com/anubis/subdomains/{domain} is the live host (research C0023); the legacy mirror jldc.me now answers 301 to jonlu.ca (2026-11-26) and is never used. Scripted clients sometimes get a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' page (HTTP 403): BLOCKED 'challenge', never retried with another UA or identity (A9, P016 cond 9).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P016, module subdomains_passive_extra). jldc.me is listed because the research names it (legacy mirror, 301 to an undeclared host): no module contacts it.
